title: Confidence-bin gap mining contract (L21)

invariants.name: bin_enum_only
invariants.description: confidence_bin value MUST be in {deep, borderline, marginal}.
must: validator rejects unknown bin value
bin_enum read from this contract, not hardcoded in Python

invariants.name: bin_ranges_fixed
must: bin_ranges map matches contract values at module init
half-open intervals: lower inclusive, upper exclusive (except marginal upper which is exclusive 0.6)
boundary value 0.2 belongs to borderline (not deep); 0.4 to marginal

invariants.name: no_signal_at_high_confidence
invariants.description: confidence >= 0.6 produces NO gap signal. Bin not assigned.
must: gap_intake skips signal generation when result.confidence >= 0.6
no_signal_threshold default 0.6 (configurable)
preserves current production behavior (confidence>=0.6 was already 'no gap')

invariants.name: per_bin_candidate_budget
invariants.description: Each bin has its own bin_candidates_per_tick budget. Default 10. Operator-tunable per profile.
must: default 10 per bin
profile config may override per bin
budget enforced at autogrowth_scheduler tick boundary

invariants.name: independent_pipelines
invariants.description: Deep candidates do NOT crowd out borderline/marginal candidates. Each bin's budget is committed independently.
must: scheduler runs three independent candidate-generation passes per tick
exhausting deep budget does NOT consume borderline budget
passes are deterministic order: deep -> borderline -> marginal

invariants.name: bin_specific_strategy
invariants.description: deep -> new capability_id; borderline -> new solver within capability; marginal -> routing tweak. Strategy registry maps bin -> generator.
must: candidate generator registry implements all three strategies
deep generator MUST produce candidates with NEW capability_id (not in registry today)
borderline generator MUST reuse existing capability_id but produce a new solver_id
marginal generator MUST produce a routing artifact (signal-registry addition / tunnel hint), not a new solver

invariants.name: backward_compat_default_borderline
invariants.description: Existing gap signals without confidence_bin default to 'borderline'. Migration is non-breaking.
must: signal record without confidence_bin field treated as bin='borderline'
no historical data migration required
old gap_intake call sites continue to work unchanged

out_of_scope: Implementation of bin-specific candidate generators (separate PRs)
Cross-bin candidate de-duplication (separate ADR if benefit measured)
